content.comment_body: Hello, I have an [product_name] module and a [product_name] basic module, and I want to implement dimming. Can these two modules be used for dimming, and how should I connect and program them?

You should use a dimmer that accepts a 0-10 V input, which you can connect to the [product_name] module. Regarding programming, there are different approaches depending on your requirements. What specific functionality do you need for your program?

Thank you for your response. I thought the [product_name] module could act as a dimmer since it has two 0-10 V inputs. My connections on the [product_name] are: V+1, M, I1, V+2, M, I2. On the basic module I have I8 and I1 as inputs, and Q4 and Q1 as outputs. I need advice on connecting inputs and outputs, and how to set up the dimmer lighting so that a long press of a push button will change the light intensity up or down.
The new question has been moved to the German forum: Dimmer for advertising light using [product_name] module.

There is some confusion regarding whether the module itself performs dimming or needs to be connected to a dedicated dimmer device.
